title: Install the CLI
description: How to install the command-line tool, configure it and check the result.

props.content:
# Install the CLI

The tool runs on Node 22 or later. See [Requirements](#requirements) first, or skip to [Configure](/configure).

## Requirements

| Platform | Supported | Notes |
|:---------|:---------:|------:|
| Linux | yes | x64 and arm64 |
| macOS | yes | 13 or later |
| Windows | yes | through PowerShell |

## Steps

1. Install the package
   - with pnpm: `pnpm add -g example-cli`
   - or from a release archive
2. Check the version
3. Write the settings file

```bash
# install it once
pnpm add -g example-cli
example --version
```

```json
{ "region": "eu", "retries": 3 }
```
